about: Names in common use for bills that no publisher records as a title. Entered by hand; stored in bill_titles with source 'govgraph' and kind 'common' by load-bill-names.js. Add a name only when Congress.gov's titles (popular, short, official) do not already contain it.

names.name: Green New Deal
names.note: Its only titles are the official ones ("Recognizing the duty of the Federal Government to create a Green New Deal."); it has no short or popular title. Known as the Green New Deal resolution.

names.name: Green New Deal
names.note: The Senate's version of H.Res. 109 (116th), with the same official title and no short or popular title.
